name: Holo4 (27B dense, 35B-A3B MoE)

lineage.base_model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (27B) and Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (35B-A3B); predecessor Holo3.1 (record holo-3.1)
lineage.how_derived: supervised and reinforcement learning on a large set of environments and tasks, including those generated by the vendor's Agentic Task Factory

purpose: Generalist computer-use agents that act through whichever interface fits: clicks and typing on screenshots, code, MCP or API tool calls, on desktop, web and Android, for real business workflows (vendor blog).

license.name: 27B: CC BY-NC 4.0; 35B-A3B: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE files read: Holo4-27B ships the CC BY-NC 4.0 text (non-commercial) plus the Apache text of its Qwen3.8 base; Holo4-35B-A3B ships Apache-2.0 only. So the 27B weights are not for commercial use; the 35B-A3B is unrestricted. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: 27B: dense Qwen3.8 vision-language; 35B-A3B: Qwen3.6 MoE vision-language
architecture.why_this_design: not stated beyond building on Qwen bases; the vendor argues models trained for a single interface (GUI only or tool calling only) fail when a business task mixes both

variants.notes: plus mmproj f16 0.93 GB; BF16 repo about 54.7 GB; FP8 and NVFP4 repos exist
plus mmproj f16 0.9 GB; BF16 repo about 70.2 GB; FP8 and NVFP4 repos exist

pc-12gb.notes: 22.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included; the rest in system RAM (expert offload, active parameters are few)

pc-16gb.notes: 22.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included; the rest in system RAM (expert offload, active parameters are few)

pc-24gb.notes: 17.8 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 17.8 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 17.8 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 17.8 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 17.8 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Official Q4_K_M GGUFs with mmproj exist for both; the card points to the hai-agents harness for the screenshot-action loop.

benchmarks.name: OSWorld
benchmarks.variant: Holo4-27B (35B-A3B 80.8; Qwen3.8-27B base 84.3 in the vendor's harness)
benchmarks.harness: H Company hai-agents, mean of 2-4 runs

benchmarks.name: ALE-CLI (Agents' Last Exam, 105 Linux tasks) score
Agentic Task Factory, web / MCP / desktop (held-out, vendor-generated)

strengths: a real gain over its Qwen base on desktop and long-workflow tasks (OSWorld 2.0 +13.7 points for the 27B)
one model for GUI, code and tool calls
all evaluation trajectories published (Hcompany/trajectories) for inspection
weaknesses: on plain OSWorld the 27B is only 0.9 points above its own base (85.2 vs 84.3, vendor harness)
the 35B-A3B trails the 27B by 4 to 30 points on the long benchmarks
all scores are vendor runs in the vendor's harness
best_for: desktop and web GUI automation from screenshots
computer-use workers that also need code and tool calls
soft.maturity: fourth generation in a year (Holo3.1 before); 27B 2.7k and 35B-A3B 1.6k downloads, collection plus Holotron4-30B-A3B (NemotronH Nano Omni)

tona_fit.reason: The most relevant new GUI/computer-use release for coding-agent workers: the 35B-A3B is 3B active and runs from RAM on 16 GB cards (21.3 GB Q4_K_M), the 27B is the quality pick on 24 GB. Gains over the base model are real on long workflows but the harness is the vendor's.
blockers: no Tona module for Qwen3.8 dense / Qwen3.6 MoE vision paths

open_questions: quality of the Q4_K_M GGUFs on GUI grounding (vendor numbers are BF16)
which screenshot resolution the grounding needs
